team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 29 (12 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Internet and ordinary tools are generally allowed for Mystery Hunt solving.
Do not ask other competing teams for answers.
Respect answer checker / rate-limit norms; do not spam guesses recklessly.
Submit the canonical puzzle answer string.
No official maximum team size; 2026 FAQ: finish-oriented teams often need 30+ experienced solvers; designed for varied sizes.
Weekend MLK hunt; kickoff Friday; remote play possible for most content, but in-person runaround required to win; ≥1 current MIT student required to win/write next year.
Heavy within-team coordination; internet/tools generally unrestricted as a community puzzlehunt (not a closed-book exam) — year FAQ does not impose calculator/AI bans.
Benchmark is question-level puzzle subsample with answers, not a full hunt.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain and batch submitter
duties: Decide when the current batch is good enough to commit.
Keep a running list of which problems are answered and which are open.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: fast solver A
duties: Clear the easy problems in the current batch quickly and accurately.
Hand off anything that needs deep work instead of stalling the batch.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3

duties: Clear the easy problems in the current batch quickly and accurately.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: strategy lead
duties: Decide which problems are worth attempting for the points available.
Call the trade-off between accuracy and speed for each batch.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: scribe
duties: Keep the shared workspace readable and current.
Write answers in the required format as they are settled.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: backup solver
duties: Take the problems nobody has claimed rather than duplicating work.
Say early when a problem is beyond the remaining time.

crawled_excerpts.excerpt: MIT Mystery Hunt / Puzzle Club The MIT Mystery Hunt is a puzzlehunt competition that takes place on the MIT campus every year during the Martin Luther King, Jr. Day weekend . The hunt challenges each participating team to solve a large number of puzzles which lead to an object (called a "coin") hidden somewhere on campus.
